product_risk_or_requirement: The triage use case has no signed legal classification against the AI Law and the official high-risk list
current_state: Only a preliminary internal reading exists and the provider or deployer role is undecided
product_requirement: Production release is blocked until counsel maps the deployed workflow to the law, its implementing instruments and the published high-risk list, and records the resulting obligations in the AI inventory
acceptance_criteria: Given the final pilot scope and the Vietnamese market When production readiness is reviewed Then a signed classification memo, the assigned role and an AI inventory entry are present and referenced in the release pack
evidence_needed: Signed classification memo, role determination and AI inventory record

product_risk_or_requirement: Symptom intake, free text and transcripts are health data processed by a vendor outside the hospital boundary
current_state: A data-processing agreement is signed but the lawful basis, impact assessment, retention limit and transfer path are not evidenced
product_requirement: The product must process intake data on a documented lawful basis with a completed impact assessment, a tested retention limit and an approved transfer path before real patient data enters the vendor call
acceptance_criteria: Given a real patient intake When the assistant calls the vendor model Then the transfer path, consent wording, redaction step and retention limit match the approved impact assessment and are demonstrable in an audit sample
evidence_needed: Impact assessment, consent and notice wording, retention test evidence and vendor transfer approval

product_risk_or_requirement: An EU clinic launch would place a health triage support function on the European market with an undetermined regulatory route
current_state: No role analysis and no medical-device determination have been done
product_requirement: Block the European launch until counsel determines the applicable route and the resulting obligations, and until the corresponding evidence pack is assembled
acceptance_criteria: Given a candidate European clinic launch When launch approval is requested Then a signed applicability analysis, the medical-device determination and the matching risk-management and oversight evidence are complete
deadline_or_trigger: Before offering the product in the European Union
evidence_needed: Applicability analysis, medical-device determination and the evidence pack the chosen route requires

product_risk_or_requirement: A generated draft could downgrade or hide a red-flag symptom
current_state: Red-flag rules are specified on paper and partially implemented, and there is no end-to-end demonstration
product_requirement: The deterministic red-flag rule set must run outside the model, must be able to escalate but never downgrade, and must keep the emergency instruction visible even when the model output is empty or wrong
acceptance_criteria: Given an intake containing any listed red-flag symptom When the model proposes a lower urgency or fails Then the case is escalated, the emergency instruction is shown to the patient and no path exists to close or downgrade the case without a nurse decision record
deadline_or_trigger: Before the first real patient intake in the pilot
evidence_needed: Rule specification signed by the clinical lead plus a demonstrated end-to-end test run including model-failure cases

product_risk_or_requirement: Under-triage and subgroup performance are unmeasured, so the true miss rate is unknown
current_state: Only vendor demonstrations and informal review exist, with no retrospective evaluation on our own case mix
product_requirement: The product must be evaluated on a representative retrospective set of adult intakes with clinician-assigned reference dispositions, reported overall and by age band, language, insurance status and province
acceptance_criteria: Given the retrospective evaluation set When the release pack is reviewed Then the under-triage rate, the subgroup breakdown and the alert volume are reported against the agreed thresholds and signed by the clinical safety committee
evidence_needed: Evaluation protocol, reference-standard method, under-triage and subgroup results, and committee sign-off

product_risk_or_requirement: Nurse review can become a rubber stamp if the nurse lacks time, information or authority
current_state: Nurses can override in the console design but there is no measured capacity, no reason-code requirement and no evidence under peak load
product_requirement: Meaningful human oversight must be demonstrable: the nurse sees the patient's own words and the draft's basis, has staffed time per case, records a reason code, and can override or pause without waiting for approval
acceptance_criteria: Given a peak-load shift in the pilot When intakes are worked in the console Then median review time per case, reason-code completeness and override rate are recorded, and a nurse can pause the assistant without product or vendor approval
deadline_or_trigger: Before the first real patient intake in the pilot
evidence_needed: Staffing and capacity plan, console walkthrough, peak-load rehearsal log and pause-authority sign-off

product_risk_or_requirement: The vendor can change the model or the served prompt without notice, as happened in the chatbot case we studied
current_state: The contract has no change-notice clause, no version pinning and no automatic regression gate
product_requirement: No model or prompt version may serve patients before it passes the golden test set and is approved, and the product must be able to pin back to the last approved version without vendor cooperation
acceptance_criteria: Given a new vendor model or prompt version When it is offered to production Then traffic is blocked until the golden test set passes and the clinical safety officer approves, and a pin-back to the previous approved version is demonstrated
evidence_needed: Signed contract clause on change notice, version-pinning evidence and a golden test report per version

product_risk_or_requirement: Untrusted patient free text can carry injected instructions that suppress protocol wording or leak context
current_state: Patient text is passed to the model without a tested separation between data and instruction
product_requirement: Patient content must be handled as data only, injection test cases must run in the release suite, and the red-flag rules must stay outside anything a prompt can influence
acceptance_criteria: Given the release candidate When the injection test suite runs Then no test case suppresses the red-flag wording or exposes system or other-case context, and any failure blocks promotion to the pilot environment
deadline_or_trigger: Before opening free-text intake to all pilot users
evidence_needed: Injection test suite, results per release and a fallback plan to structured-question intake

product_risk_or_requirement: Evaluation and demonstration environments must never contain real patient records
current_state: Synthetic and de-identified intake sets were created and reviewed for the pilot build
product_requirement: All non-production environments and every artefact shared for teaching or review must use synthetic or de-identified data only, with a documented review before use
acceptance_criteria: Given any non-production environment or shared artefact When it is created or updated Then a signed data-review record shows only synthetic or de-identified content and no real patient identifiers are present
deadline_or_trigger: Completed before the pilot build was released to the team
evidence_needed: Signed data-review record for the synthetic intake set and the demonstration environment
